subject.title: [codex] Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw core add an Even Hub glasses client id to the setup-code bootstrap handoff path now, and which stable wire id should be approved for that auth boundary?
rationale: The code is narrow and proof-backed, but it adds a new protocol identity to an auth path that can hand out bounded operator credentials, and automation should not choose that trust boundary or stable id.

options.title: Approve a stable Even Hub bootstrap identity
options.body: A Gateway/security owner approves the trust boundary and selected id, the branch rebases over current main, and the focused slice can proceed after checks are green.

options.title: Rename before merge
options.body: If maintainers prefer a generation-agnostic id, update the registry, tests, docs, SDK baseline, and external-app expectation before landing.

options.title: Keep the app external for now
options.body: If core should not own this identity yet, pause or close this preview and keep the external app on generic node pairing while the broader issue remains open.

recommendation.title: Approve a stable Even Hub bootstrap identity
recommendation.body: A Gateway/security owner approves the trust boundary and selected id, the branch rebases over current main, and the focused slice can proceed after checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the official project owner in CONTRIBUTING.md and has recent history on the affected Gateway protocol and pairing surfaces.
